#  Shaders

Complete, runnable shaders for each demo in the notes.

---

## Common Infrastructure

All shaders in this chapter use the same boilerplate: ray generation, orbit camera, gradient-based normals, raymarching, and diffuse shading. Each shader below is self-contained — paste it into Shadertoy and it runs.

The primitive SDFs appear as bare helper functions (`sdSphere`, `sdBox`, etc.) rather than structs, to keep the demos compact. The notes explain the struct convention; the shaders use the shorthand.

---

## punched-sphere

A sphere with three cylindrical holes along the coordinate axes.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float radius, float halfHeight) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - radius, abs(p.y) - halfHeight);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    // Start with a sphere
    float d = sdSphere(p, 1.0);

    // Subtract three cylinders along coordinate axes
    d = max(d, -sdCylinder(p,     0.4, 1.2));  // y-axis
    d = max(d, -sdCylinder(p.yzx, 0.4, 1.2));  // x-axis
    d = max(d, -sdCylinder(p.zxy, 0.4, 1.2));  // z-axis

    // Add ground plane
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.5);
    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdPlane(p, -1.5) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.9, 0.3, 0.2);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 5.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## steinmetz

Intersection of three orthogonal cylinders (a Steinmetz solid).

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float radius, float halfHeight) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - radius, abs(p.y) - halfHeight);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    // Three cylinders along coordinate axes
    float cylY = sdCylinder(p,     1.0, 2.0);  // y-axis
    float cylX = sdCylinder(p.yzx, 1.0, 2.0);  // x-axis
    float cylZ = sdCylinder(p.zxy, 1.0, 2.0);  // z-axis

    // Intersection: keep only where all three overlap
    float d = max(cylY, max(cylX, cylZ));

    // Add ground plane
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.5);
    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdPlane(p, -1.5) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.2, 0.6, 0.9);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 5.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## scooped-cube

A cube with a sphere subtracted from one corner.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.62, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 halfSize) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    // Start with a cube
    float cube = sdBox(p, vec3(1.0));

    // Sphere at the corner to subtract
    float scoop = sdSphere(p - vec3(1.0), 1.2);

    // Subtraction: keep cube, remove sphere
    float d = max(cube, -scoop);

    // Add ground plane
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.5);
    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdPlane(p, -1.5) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.85, 0.75, 0.5);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 5.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## crease-problem-2d

Two circles: hard union on the left, smooth union on the right. Shows the crease vs. the fillet.

```glsl
float sdCircle(vec2 p, vec2 c, float r) {
    return length(p - c) - r;
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 2.5;

    // Left side: hard union (min)
    float d1L = sdCircle(p, vec2(-1.8, 0.3), 0.8);
    float d2L = sdCircle(p, vec2(-1.2, -0.3), 0.8);
    float dLeft = min(d1L, d2L);

    // Right side: smooth union (smin)
    float d1R = sdCircle(p, vec2(1.2, 0.3), 0.8);
    float d2R = sdCircle(p, vec2(1.8, -0.3), 0.8);
    float dRight = smin(d1R, d2R, 0.5);

    // Pick side
    float d = (p.x < 0.0) ? dLeft : dRight;

    // Color by sign
    vec3 color;
    if (d < 0.0) {
        color = vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8);
    } else {
        color = vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.2);
    }

    color *= 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * abs(d));

    // Contour lines
    float contour = abs(fract(d * 4.0 + 0.5) - 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, contour));

    // Zero set
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));

    // Divider
    color = mix(vec3(0.5), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.01, abs(p.x)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## smin-1d

1D graph showing min(a,b) vs smin(a,b,k) for several k values.

```glsl
float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

float line(vec2 p, float y, float thickness) {
    return smoothstep(thickness, 0.0, abs(p.y - y));
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 3.0;

    // Two linear functions
    float a = 0.7 * p.x + 0.5;
    float b = -0.7 * p.x + 0.5;

    vec3 color = vec3(0.95);

    // Grid
    float grid = smoothstep(0.02, 0.0, abs(fract(p.x) - 0.5)) +
                 smoothstep(0.02, 0.0, abs(fract(p.y) - 0.5));
    color -= vec3(0.08) * grid;

    // Axes
    color -= vec3(0.3) * smoothstep(0.02, 0.0, abs(p.x));
    color -= vec3(0.3) * smoothstep(0.02, 0.0, abs(p.y));

    float px = 3.0 / iResolution.y;

    // Draw a and b as thin gray lines
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.7), line(p, a, 2.0 * px));
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.7), line(p, b, 2.0 * px));

    // Hard min: red
    float hardMin = min(a, b);
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.9, 0.2, 0.2), line(p, hardMin, 3.0 * px));

    // smin with k = 0.5: blue
    float sm1 = smin(a, b, 0.5);
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.9), line(p, sm1, 3.0 * px));

    // smin with k = 1.0: green
    float sm2 = smin(a, b, 1.0);
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.2, 0.8, 0.4), line(p, sm2, 3.0 * px));

    // smin with k = 2.0: orange
    float sm3 = smin(a, b, 2.0);
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.1), line(p, sm3, 3.0 * px));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## smooth-union-spheres

Two spheres joined with smooth union, on a ground plane.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Smooth Operations ---

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    // Two spheres
    float sphere1 = sdSphere(p - vec3(-0.6, 0.0, 0.0), 0.8);
    float sphere2 = sdSphere(p - vec3( 0.6, 0.0, 0.0), 0.8);

    // Smooth union blends them together
    float d = smin(sphere1, sphere2, 0.4);

    // Add ground plane
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.2);
    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdPlane(p, -1.2) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.9, 0.4, 0.3);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 5.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## smooth-subtraction

A sphere with a smooth bite taken out.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.65, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Smooth Operations ---

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

float ssubtract(float a, float b, float k) {
    return -smin(-a, b, k);
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    // Main sphere
    float sphere = sdSphere(p, 1.0);

    // Sphere to subtract (the "bite")
    float bite = sdSphere(p - vec3(0.7, 0.0, 0.0), 0.9);

    // Smooth subtraction creates a fillet at the edge
    float d = ssubtract(sphere, bite, 0.15);

    // Add ground plane
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.5);
    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdPlane(p, -1.5) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.3, 0.7, 0.5);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

    if (t > 0.0) {

        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
```

## displacement

A sphere with sinusoidal displacement creating a bumpy surface.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


// More steps needed for displacement (conservative stepping)
const int MAX_STEPS = 200;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.0005;
const float STEP_SCALE = 0.7;  // Conservative step for non-Lipschitz SDF

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    // Base sphere
    float sphere = length(p) - 1.0;

    // Add sinusoidal displacement (makes surface bumpy)
    sphere += 0.05 * sin(12.0 * p.x) * sin(12.0 * p.y) * sin(12.0 * p.z);

    // Ground plane
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.5);

    return min(sphere, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdPlane(p, -1.5) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.7, 0.5, 0.3);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        // Conservative step: displacement breaks Lipschitz property
        t += d * STEP_SCALE;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.5);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## symmetry

A few primitives in the positive octant, mirrored with abs(p) to get 8-fold symmetry.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.58, 0.52);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 halfSize) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Smooth Operations ---

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    // Fold space into positive octant (8-fold symmetry)
    vec3 q = abs(p);

    // A sphere near the corner
    float sphere = sdSphere(q - vec3(1.2, 0.4, 0.2), 0.35);

    // A box along an edge
    float box = sdBox(q - vec3(0.0, 0.9, 0.9), vec3(0.6, 0.15, 0.15));

    // Blend them smoothly
    float d = smin(sphere, box, 0.15);

    // Ground plane
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.8);

    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdPlane(p, -1.8) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.85, 0.5, 0.2);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 6.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## repetition

A sphere tiled infinitely in xz with mod, on a ground plane.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 150;
const float MAX_DIST = 80.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.58, 0.58);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

const float SPACING = 3.0;

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    // Repeat in xz plane using mod
    vec3 q = p;
    q.xz = mod(p.xz + SPACING * 0.5, SPACING) - SPACING * 0.5;

    float sphere = sdSphere(q, 0.6);
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.0);

    return min(sphere, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdPlane(p, -1.0) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.9, 0.4, 0.3);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 8.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 skyColor = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    vec3 color = skyColor;

    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    // Distance fog blends to sky color
    float fog = 1.0 - exp(-0.015 * t * t);
    color = mix(color, skyColor, fog);

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## finite-repetition

```glsl
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);

    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
```

```glsl
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 halfSize) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

const float TWIST_RATE = 2.0;

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    // Twist around y-axis
    float angle = TWIST_RATE * p.y;
    float c = cos(angle), s = sin(angle);
    vec3 q = vec3(c * p.x - s * p.z, p.y, s * p.x + c * p.z);

    // Square cross-section column
    float column = sdBox(q, vec3(0.4, 2.0, 0.4));

    // Pedestal base
    float base = sdBox(p - vec3(0.0, -2.15, 0.0), vec3(0.7, 0.15, 0.7));

    // Ground plane
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -2.0);

    return min(min(column, base), ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdPlane(p, -2.0) < eps) return vec3(0.3, 0.28, 0.28);
    return vec3(0.9, 0.85, 0.75);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        // Conservative step for twisted geometry
        t += d * STEP_SCALE;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 7.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## corridor

Repeated columns in xz forming an infinite colonnade with floor and ceiling.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 200;
const float MAX_DIST = 60.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.52, 0.52);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 1.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float radius, float halfHeight) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - radius, abs(p.y) - halfHeight);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

// --- Scene ---

const float SPACING = 5.0;

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    // Floor and ceiling
    float floorDist = p.y + 2.0;
    float ceilingDist = -(p.y - 4.0);

    // Repeated columns in xz
    vec3 q = p;
    q.xz = mod(p.xz + SPACING * 0.5, SPACING) - SPACING * 0.5;
    float column = sdCylinder(q, 0.35, 2.0);

    return min(floorDist, min(ceilingDist, column));
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    // Check what we're closest to
    float floorDist = p.y + 2.0;
    float ceilingDist = -(p.y - 4.0);

    vec3 q = p;
    q.xz = mod(p.xz + SPACING * 0.5, SPACING) - SPACING * 0.5;
    float column = sdCylinder(q, 0.35, 2.0);

    if (column < eps) return vec3(0.9, 0.85, 0.75);  // Columns: warm stone
    if (floorDist < eps) return vec3(0.4, 0.35, 0.32);  // Floor: dark stone
    return vec3(0.5, 0.48, 0.45);  // Ceiling: light stone
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 8.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 skyColor = vec3(0.3, 0.4, 0.6);
    vec3 color = skyColor;

    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.25;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    // Distance fog
    float fog = 1.0 - exp(-0.008 * t * t);
    color = mix(color, skyColor, fog);

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## symmetric-sculpture

Primitives in the positive octant, smooth-unioned, then abs(q) for octant symmetry.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float focalLength = 1.0 / tan(radians(50.0) / 2.0);
    vec3 rayDir = normalize(vec3(uv, -focalLength));

    return Ray(vec3(0.0), rayDir);
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.58, 0.48);

    float pitch = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14159;
    float yaw = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28318;

    mat3 rotation = rotateX(pitch) * rotateY(yaw);
    ray.origin = rotation * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rotation * ray.dir;

    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 halfSize) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdTorus(vec3 p, float majorRadius, float minorRadius) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - majorRadius, p.y);
    return length(q) - minorRadius;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdSculpture(vec3 p) {
    // Mirror into positive octant
    vec3 q = abs(p);

    // Sphere at corner
    float sphere = sdSphere(q - vec3(1.0, 0.6, 0.3), 0.3);

    // Torus ring at origin
    float torus = sdTorus(q, 1.2, 0.12);

    // Connecting pillar
    float pillar = sdBox(q - vec3(0.5, 0.0, 0.5), vec3(0.12, 0.8, 0.12));

    // Smooth blend all parts
    float d = smin(sphere, torus, 0.2);
    d = smin(d, pillar, 0.15);

    return d;
}

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float sculpture = sdSculpture(p);
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.8);
    return min(sculpture, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdSculpture(p) < eps) return vec3(0.75, 0.55, 0.85);  // Purple sculpture
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);  // Gray ground
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 6.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);

    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## mug

Coffee mug: hollow cylinder + torus handle with smooth union.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float focalLength = 1.0 / tan(radians(50.0) / 2.0);
    vec3 rayDir = normalize(vec3(uv, -focalLength));

    return Ray(vec3(0.0), rayDir);
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.62, 0.52);

    float pitch = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14159;
    float yaw = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28318;

    mat3 rotation = rotateX(pitch) * rotateY(yaw);
    ray.origin = rotation * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rotation * ray.dir;

    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float radius, float halfHeight) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - radius, abs(p.y) - halfHeight);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

float sdTorus(vec3 p, float majorRadius, float minorRadius) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - majorRadius, p.y);
    return length(q) - minorRadius;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdMug(vec3 p) {
    // Outer cylinder
    float outer = sdCylinder(p, 0.5, 0.5);

    // Inner cavity (shifted up to preserve bottom)
    float inner = sdCylinder(p - vec3(0.0, 0.05, 0.0), 0.45, 0.5);
    float body = max(outer, -inner);

    // Handle: torus arc, clipped to outer portion
    vec3 hp = p - vec3(0.5, 0.0, 0.0);
    hp = hp.xzy;  // Stand torus upright
    float torus = sdTorus(hp, 0.3, 0.07);
    float handle = max(torus, max(hp.y - 0.2, -hp.x));  // Clip inner and outer edges

    return smin(body, handle, 0.08);
}

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float mug = sdMug(p);
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -0.55);
    return min(mug, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdMug(p) < eps) return vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.78);  // Cream ceramic
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);  // Gray surface
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 3.5);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);

    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

```glsl
const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {

}

    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.58);

    float pitch = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14159;
    float yaw = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28318;

    mat3 rotation = rotateX(pitch) * rotateY(yaw);
    ray.origin = rotation * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rotation * ray.dir;

    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float radius, float halfHeight) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - radius, abs(p.y) - halfHeight);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

// --- Dish (plate/saucer) ---

float sdDish(vec3 p, float radius) {
    float holeRadius = radius * 0.75;
    float base = sdCylinder(p, radius, 0.04);
    vec3 rp = p - vec3(0.0, 0.03, 0.0);
    float ring = sdCylinder(rp, radius, 0.03);
    float hole = sdCylinder(rp, holeRadius, 0.1);
    float rim = max(ring, -hole);
    return smin(base, rim, 0.06);
}

struct Dish {
    vec3 center;
    float radius;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Dish d) {
    return sdDish(p - d.center, d.radius);
}

// --- Scene ---

Dish saucer = Dish(vec3(0.0), 0.7, vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.78));

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float d = sdf(p, saucer);
    d = min(d, sdPlane(p, -0.1));
    return d;
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdf(p, saucer) < eps) return saucer.color;
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);  // Gray surface
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 3.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);

    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

```glsl
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

// --- Dish (plate/saucer) ---

float sdDish(vec3 p, float radius) {
    float holeRadius = radius * 0.75;
    float base = sdCylinder(p, radius, 0.04);
    vec3 rp = p - vec3(0.0, 0.03, 0.0);
    float ring = sdCylinder(rp, radius, 0.03);
    float hole = sdCylinder(rp, holeRadius, 0.1);
    float rim = max(ring, -hole);
    return smin(base, rim, 0.06);
}

struct Dish {
    vec3 center;
    float radius;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Dish d) {
    return sdDish(p - d.center, d.radius);
}

// --- Scene Components ---

Dish plate = Dish(vec3(0.0), 1.0, vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.78));

float sdDonut(vec3 p) {
    vec3 q = p - vec3(0.0, 0.23, 0.0);
    return sdTorus(q, 0.35, 0.15);
}

float sdIcing(vec3 p) {
    vec3 q = p - vec3(0.0, 0.23, 0.0);

    // Slightly larger torus, clipped to top half
    float icing = sdTorus(q, 0.35, 0.17);
    icing = max(icing, -q.y - 0.02);  // Keep only top (y > -0.02)

    // Bumpy texture
    icing += 0.008 * sin(40.0 * q.x) * sin(40.0 * q.y) * sin(40.0 * q.z);

    return icing;
}

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float d = sdf(p, plate);
    float donut = sdDonut(p);
    float icing = sdIcing(p);
    float donutWithIcing = smin(donut, icing, 0.03);

    d = min(d, donutWithIcing);
    d = min(d, sdPlane(p, -0.1));
    return d;
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdIcing(p) < eps) return vec3(0.9, 0.45, 0.55);   // Pink icing
    if (sdDonut(p) < eps) return vec3(0.8, 0.6, 0.35);    // Golden donut
    if (sdf(p, plate) < eps) return plate.color;
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);  // Gray surface
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d * 0.8;  // Relaxation for displacement

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);

    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.2;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## table

Table with box tabletop and four box legs, smooth-unioned.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float focalLength = 1.0 / tan(radians(50.0) / 2.0);
    vec3 rayDir = normalize(vec3(uv, -focalLength));

    return Ray(vec3(0.0), rayDir);
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.58, 0.55);

    float pitch = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14159;
    float yaw = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28318;

    mat3 rotation = rotateX(pitch) * rotateY(yaw);
    ray.origin = rotation * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rotation * ray.dir;

    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 halfSize) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdTable(vec3 p) {
    // Tabletop
    float top = sdBox(p, vec3(2.0, 0.06, 1.2));

    // Four legs
    float leg1 = sdBox(p - vec3(-1.8, -0.56, -1.0), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float leg2 = sdBox(p - vec3(-1.8, -0.56,  1.0), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float leg3 = sdBox(p - vec3( 1.8, -0.56, -1.0), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float leg4 = sdBox(p - vec3( 1.8, -0.56,  1.0), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float legs = min(min(leg1, leg2), min(leg3, leg4));

    return smin(top, legs, 0.04);
}

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float table = sdTable(p);
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.1);
    return min(table, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdTable(p) < eps) return vec3(0.55, 0.35, 0.2);  // Warm wood
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);  // Gray floor
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

float shadow(vec3 p) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float t = 0.02;

    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sdScene(p + lightDir * t);

        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;

        t += d;

        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }

    return 1.0;
}

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 7.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);

    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        float sh = shadow(p + normal * 0.01);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.15;
        vec3 lit = shade(normal, material);
        color = ambient + lit * sh;
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## breakfast-scene

The full scene: mug on saucer, plate with iced donut, all on a table.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};


const int MAX_STEPS = 150;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.0005;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float focalLength = 1.0 / tan(radians(50.0) / 2.0);
    vec3 rayDir = normalize(vec3(uv, -focalLength));

    return Ray(vec3(0.0), rayDir);
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.58, 0.52);

    float pitch = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14159;
    float yaw = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28318;

    mat3 rotation = rotateX(pitch) * rotateY(yaw);
    ray.origin = rotation * vec3(0.0, 0.5, distance);
    ray.dir = rotation * ray.dir;

    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 halfSize) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float radius, float halfHeight) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - radius, abs(p.y) - halfHeight);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

float sdTorus(vec3 p, float majorRadius, float minorRadius) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - majorRadius, p.y);
    return length(q) - minorRadius;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

// --- Dish (plate/saucer) ---

float sdDish(vec3 p, float radius) {
    float holeRadius = radius * 0.75;
    float base = sdCylinder(p, radius, 0.04);
    vec3 rp = p - vec3(0.0, 0.03, 0.0);
    float ring = sdCylinder(rp, radius, 0.03);
    float hole = sdCylinder(rp, holeRadius, 0.1);
    float rim = max(ring, -hole);
    return smin(base, rim, 0.06);
}

struct Dish {
    vec3 center;
    float radius;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Dish d) {
    return sdDish(p - d.center, d.radius);
}

// --- Scene Components ---

float sdMug(vec3 p) {
    vec3 mp = p - vec3(-1.0, 0.62, 0.0);

    // Hollow body
    float outer = sdCylinder(mp, 0.5, 0.5);
    float inner = sdCylinder(mp - vec3(0.0, 0.05, 0.0), 0.45, 0.5);
    float body = max(outer, -inner);

    // Handle: torus arc, clipped to outer portion
    vec3 hp = mp - vec3(0.5, 0.0, 0.0);
    hp = hp.xzy;  // Stand torus upright
    float torus = sdTorus(hp, 0.3, 0.07);
    float handle = max(torus, max(hp.y - 0.2, -hp.x));  // Clip inner and outer edges

    return smin(body, handle, 0.08);
}

Dish saucer = Dish(vec3(-1.0, 0.07, 0.0), 0.85, vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.78));
Dish plate = Dish(vec3(1.2, 0.07, 0.0), 1.0, vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.78));

float sdDonut(vec3 p) {
    vec3 dp = p - vec3(1.2, 0.3, 0.0);
    return sdTorus(dp, 0.35, 0.15);
}

float sdIcing(vec3 p) {
    vec3 dp = p - vec3(1.2, 0.3, 0.0);

    // Slightly larger torus, clipped to top half
    float icing = sdTorus(dp, 0.35, 0.17);
    icing = max(icing, -dp.y - 0.02);  // Keep only top (y > -0.02)

    // Bumpy texture
    icing += 0.008 * sin(40.0 * dp.x) * sin(40.0 * dp.y) * sin(40.0 * dp.z);

    return icing;
}

float sdTable(vec3 p) {
    // Tabletop
    float top = sdBox(p, vec3(2.5, 0.06, 1.5));

    // Four legs
    float leg1 = sdBox(p - vec3(-2.3, -0.56, -1.3), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float leg2 = sdBox(p - vec3(-2.3, -0.56,  1.3), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float leg3 = sdBox(p - vec3( 2.3, -0.56, -1.3), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float leg4 = sdBox(p - vec3( 2.3, -0.56,  1.3), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float legs = min(min(leg1, leg2), min(leg3, leg4));

    return smin(top, legs, 0.04);
}

float sdCoffee(vec3 p) {
    vec3 cp = p - vec3(-1.0, 1.0, 0.0);  // Inside mug, below rim
    return sdCylinder(cp, 0.43, 0.02);   // Thin disc
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float mug = sdMug(p);
    float coffee = sdCoffee(p);
    float donut = sdDonut(p);
    float icing = sdIcing(p);
    float donutWithIcing = smin(donut, icing, 0.03);
    float table = sdTable(p);
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.1);

    float d = mug;
    d = min(d, coffee);
    d = min(d, sdf(p, saucer));
    d = min(d, sdf(p, plate));
    d = min(d, donutWithIcing);
    d = min(d, table);
    d = min(d, ground);

    return d;
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    // Check icing before donut (icing is on top)
    if (sdIcing(p) < eps) return vec3(0.9, 0.45, 0.55);    // Pink icing
    if (sdDonut(p) < eps) return vec3(0.8, 0.6, 0.35);     // Golden donut
    if (sdCoffee(p) < eps) return vec3(0.25, 0.15, 0.1);   // Dark coffee
    if (sdMug(p) < eps) return vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.78);     // Cream ceramic
    if (sdf(p, saucer) < eps) return saucer.color;
    if (sdf(p, plate) < eps) return plate.color;
    if (sdTable(p) < eps) return vec3(0.55, 0.35, 0.2);    // Warm wood

    return vec3(0.35, 0.32, 0.3);  // Gray floor
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d * 0.8;  // Relaxation for displacement

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

float shadow(vec3 p) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float t = 0.02;

    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sdScene(p + lightDir * t);

        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;

        t += d;

        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }

    return 1.0;
}

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 7.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);

    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        float sh = shadow(p + normal * 0.01);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.15;
        vec3 lit = shade(normal, material);
        color = ambient + lit * sh;
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```
